title: Repository optimization audit
purpose: Decide which simplifications to implement next.
task: Assess the supplied repository evidence and rank concrete simplifications.

in: Inspect the supplied evidence and propose changes.
out: Modify product files or publish changes.

requirements.requirement: Rank actionable simplifications with supporting evidence.

acceptance.condition: Each ranked change identifies evidence, effect, risk and a finite verification test.

deliverables.description: Ranked findings with evidence and open decisions.

sources.role: Entry-point description; inspect its linked features against supplied evidence.

stop_condition: Deliver the ranked report; mark gaps PARTIAL/BLOCKED with explicit limitations.
